facts.business: Man Infraconstruction Limited operates a mix of Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) and Asset Ownership/Real Estate development, executing various development and redevelopment projects directly and through subsidiaries, associates, and joint ventures.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Combined sales of ₹5,000 crores over FY27 and FY28
Launch new projects with combined GDV potential of over ₹6,700 crores

key_risks: Revenue recognition over time in construction contracts involves significant assumptions and estimates on future outcomes including costs for labour, material, subcontractors and defect liability
Forecasts may require updated estimates for completed projects and include assessments of claims on customers relating to change or additional orders and deficiencies in tender conditions
Element of assumptions and estimates means final results may deviate from those now reported
